iconRatio.$description: Icon content: glyph size as a fraction of the avatar size.

statusRatio.$description: Status indicator diameter as a fraction of the avatar size.

statusMinSize.$description: Smallest status indicator, so it stays visible on xs and sm avatars.

statusMaxSize.$description: Largest status indicator, so it stays secondary on xl avatars.

statusAwayCut.$description: Away indicator: diameter of the page-coloured circle that cuts the crescent, as a fraction of the indicator.

statusAwayOffset.$description: Away indicator: how far the cutting circle sits past the top and end edges, as a fraction of the indicator.

statusBusyBarWidth.$description: Busy indicator: bar width as a fraction of the indicator.

statusBusyBarHeight.$description: Busy indicator: bar height as a fraction of the indicator.

statusOfflineRing.$description: Offline indicator: ring thickness as a fraction of the indicator, leaving a hollow centre.

statusCutout.$description: Page-coloured ring separating the status indicator from the avatar.

ringWidth.$description: Ring and gradient ring stroke width.

ringGap.$description: Transparent gap between the avatar and its ring.

groupOverlap.$description: Avatar group: how far each avatar overlaps the previous one, as a fraction of its size.

groupCutout.$description: Avatar group: page-coloured ring that separates overlapping avatars.

popOutRatio.$description: Break the frame: cut-out portrait height as a fraction of the frame width; the excess rises above the frame.

patternInset.$description: Generated pattern: inner margin as a fraction of the avatar size, so the motif clears circular corners.

patternCells.$description: Generated pattern: cells per row and column (mirrored left to right).
